relevance_note: Narrative review of retinal vasculitis that mentions HA20 only at group level, citing ref 12 ("A novel Behçet’s-like autoinflammatory disease was recently reported due to mutations in TNFAIP3"), with no individual-level patient detail.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand. The only TNFAIP3 content is two group-level sentences in 'New insights into pathogenesis' citing reference 12 ('Patients present early in life with oral ulcers, pathergy, dermal abscesses, chorioretinal scarring, and macular fibrosis secondary to retinal vasculitis') and a Key Points line; no individual, variant, sex or age is given, so no in-scope person and no rows outside publications. The single patient described individually (Figures 1-2, a 25-year-old Saudi male) is diagnosed with Behçet's disease and has no TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis, so is out of scope. n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated left null: the review has no own cohort (the '207 patients' and other counts refer to cited studies). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null because the review reports no patients of its own. No contradictions found.

study_type.span: This report seeks to establish a common understanding of the term, retinal vasculitis, and to review recent papers on this diagnosis.
